calendarFaqs.q: When does Henderson County Schools start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day for students is Thursday, August 13, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fall Break for Henderson County Schools in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs October 5–9, 2026. October 12 is a professional development day with no school, so students return Tuesday, October 13.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break for Henderson County Schools in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a professional development day, and students return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Henderson County Schools Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, April 5 through Friday, April 9, 2027. The next scheduled student day is Monday, April 12.

calendarFaqs.q: Which HCS dates are possible make-up days in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar labels February 26 and March 1 as no-school dates that may be used as make-up days. May 27–28 are also listed as make-up days after the scheduled last student day. Check HCS announcements before relying on those dates.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Henderson County Schools in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last day for students is Tuesday, May 25, 2027. May 27–28 remain listed as make-up days.

content: The first student day moves from August 7 in 2025–26 to August 13 in 2026–27.
The scheduled last student day moves from May 19 in 2025–26 to May 25 in 2026–27.
Thanksgiving Break remains three school days, running November 25–27 in 2026–27.

sourceReviewSummary: MySchoolDates is an independent calendar reference. We reviewed the current HCS PDF, the December 2025 Board approval announcement, and HCS's advance Fall and Spring Break announcement on August 17, 2026.
sourceReviewDetailsTitle: How we checked the HCS calendar
sourceReviewDetails: We checked the first and last student days, four major breaks, professional development closures, Election Day closures, and possible make-up dates against the current one-page HCS calendar.
Return dates after breaks are identified as the next scheduled student weekdays after accounting for separately listed no-school dates.
The downloadable ICS file is a one-time import. Henderson County Schools remains the source of record for weather-related changes and activated make-up days.
